This [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Revan" /> In [[3950 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> she and [[Unidentified male soldier (Dromund Kaas)|two]] other [[Unidentified female soldier (Force push)|soldiers]] were handpicked by [[Murtog]], [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' security [[Captain/Legends|captain]], to be part of his strike team that would [[Operation supernova|ambush]] [[Meetra Surik]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] outside of Dromund Kaas' [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Kaas City]]. During the ambush [[T3-M4]], Surik's [[Droid/Legends|droid]], used his headlamp to blind the soldiers, who instinctively opened fire shortly after. They forced Surik to evade their fire and in retaliation Surik [[Force jump/Legends|jumped]] and [[Shiak|stabbed]] the nearest male soldier and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|slammed]] the other female soldier against one of the cave's walls [[Death/Legends|killing]] her instantaneously. The surviving soldiers ripped off their [[Night-vision goggles/Legends|night goggles]] and opened fire on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While they were distracted, T3 used his [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to set the surviving male soldier [[Fire/Legends|ablaze]]. The female soldier was distracted by the screams of her comrade, which allowed Surik the opportunity to [[Sai tok/Legends|cut]] through her [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and kill her.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female soldier first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Revan" />
